Apply the full gate hierarchy to one file

Source: R/gating.R
apply_gate_hierarchy.Rd

Chain: all events -> leukocytes (scatter) -> single cells -> live -> CD45+. Each step degrades gracefully: a missing viability dye or missing CD45 skips that step with a warning rather than aborting, because a panel that lacks one is still analysable.

Usage

apply_gate_hierarchy(
  rd,
  cofactor,
  cfg = list(),
  control_ref = NULL,
  singlet_k = 3,
  viability_name = NULL,
  cd45_name = "CD45",
  transform = NULL,
  overrides = NULL
)

Arguments

rd

The rd.

cofactor

Arcsinh cofactor. See derive_cofactor().

cfg

The cfg. Default list().

control_ref

The control ref.

singlet_k

The singlet k. Default 3.

viability_name

The viability name.

cd45_name

The cd45 name. Default "CD45".

transform

Intensity transform from make_transform(). Defaults to arcsinh with cofactor, which is what every caller got before the transform became selectable.

overrides

Optional per-marker override entries for THIS sample, as returned by indexing the config's sample_overrides block by sample id. See sample_override(). Absent by default, in which case every threshold is derived exactly as before.

Value

list of masks, derived geometry, thresholds, and a tidy counts table
